data.signal_type: Mineral Rights and Exploration Permit Activity
data.description: New mining right grants and exploration permits signal future mine ramp-ups and associated diesel demand growth. Key commodities to monitor: platinum (Limpopo), coal (Mpumalanga), chrome (North West), iron ore (Northern Cape).

Infrastructure project awards and construction contracts signal demand for diesel-powered plant and equipment. Monitor CIDB contractor register, national infrastructure pipeline announcements, and large public procurement awards.

data.signal_type: SARS Diesel Refund Claim Volumes (Lagging Indicator)
data.description: Upticks in SARS diesel refund claims from qualifying agricultural and mining users reflect real increases in sector diesel consumption. Published in SARS statistical releases with a lag.

Eskom Stage 2+ load shedding triggers large spikes in emergency diesel demand across mines, hospitals, telecoms towers, data centres, and commercial buildings. SA achieved 308 consecutive days without load shedding as of May 2026, reducing this demand signal temporarily â€” but any return to shedding will revive it rapidly. Industrial CAGR for diesel generators forecast at 9.35% to 2031.

When Eskom dispatches diesel-fired open-cycle gas turbine (OCGT) peaking plants (Ankerlig, Gourikwa), it is a direct indicator of very high short-term bulk diesel procurement volumes. Eskom's OCGT fleet can consume hundreds of millions of litres per dispatch cycle.
